<strong>Antes de aplicar L'Hôpital, comp: Before applying L'Hôpital, check the indeterminate form. It only works for $0/0$ and $\infty/\infty$. Applying it to a limit that is already determined gives a result different from the true one, and there is no recovering from that.
<strong>El dominio, lo primero y siempre: The domain, first and always. Half a dozen questions in this block are marked wrong for working outside the domain: an asymptote that does not exist, a logarithm of a negative number, a root that is not defined where it is evaluated.
<strong>En optimización, escribe la rest: In optimisation, write the constraint and reduce to one variable. The usual mistake is not differentiating badly: it is differentiating the wrong function because the condition in the question has not been used.
<strong>Para el área, corta el intervalo: For the area, cut the interval at the crossing points. The integral taken whole subtracts the pieces below the axis and gives a number smaller than the area. If the result comes out negative, the cutting was missing.
Cada tramo aporta un número fijo de preg: Each section contributes a fixed number of questions, drawn at random from its topics without repeating a topic while that is possible, and avoiding the most basic exercises. With 21 topics and 12 questions, a single exam does not touch them all: that is why the link at the end reproduces the same exam, and “another exam” draws a different one.
Calculas $\\int_{-1}^{1} x^3\\,dx$ para: You compute $\int_{-1}^{1} x^3\,dx$ to find the area between the curve and the axis and you get $0$. What does that mean?
Cómo sacarle partido: How to get the most out of it
Derivar con la regla de la cadena, del p: Differentiating with the chain, product and quotient rules; differentiability of a piecewise function; L'Hôpital; monotonicity, extrema, curvature and points of inflection; optimising with one constraint; the Taylor polynomial.
Dominio, recorrido y simetría; recta que: Domain, range and symmetry; the line through two points; vertex and roots of a parabola; the domain of a rational function or of a root; solving a linear programming problem; equations with exponentials and logarithms.
El <em>Mathematical Tripos</em> de Cambr: The Cambridge Mathematical Tripos was, through the nineteenth century, the hardest examination in the world: eight days of analysis problems, and a public ranking in which the first received the title of senior wrangler. It prepared people so well for solving and so badly for researching that it was eventually reformed, but it left a lesson this exam takes up: the technique of differentiating and integrating becomes automatic by doing it, and only once it is automatic is there room in your head for anything else.
El enlace de un examen corregido reprodu: The link to a marked exam reproduces the same questions with the same numbers. A teacher can do one, copy the link and pass it to the class: everyone will sit the same exam and will be able to compare results and procedures.
Elige los tramos que entran. Las pregunt: Choose the sections to include. The questions are drawn at random from the exercises of each topic in the block, avoiding the most basic ones and without repeating a topic while possible. There are no hints: the marking and the step-by-step solution come on submitting.
Integrar por partes y por cambio de vari: Integrating by parts and by substitution; splitting into partial fractions; the area between two curves, breaking the interval at the crossings; differentiating a function defined by an integral.
La integral definida suma con signo: lo: The definite integral adds with a sign: what is below the axis subtracts. The area is $\int_{-1}^{0}|x^3| + \int_{0}^{1}x^3 = 1/2$. The zero is the sign that the cutting was missing.
La primitiva está bien: $x^4/4$ vale lo: The antiderivative is right: $x^4/4$ takes the same value at $-1$ and at $1$. The problem is not the arithmetic, it is having confused the integral with the area.
Lo que vale cero es la integral, no el á: What is zero is the integral, not the area. An area is never negative or null if the curve leaves the axis; what cancel out are the two pieces against each other.
Que el área es cero porque la función es: That the area is zero because the function is odd
Que hay que partir en $x = 0$ y sumar lo: That you have to split at $x = 0$ and add the two pieces in absolute value
Que hay un error de cálculo en la primit: That there is a mistake in the antiderivative
Resolver indeterminaciones; asíntotas ve: Resolving indeterminate forms; vertical, horizontal and oblique asymptotes; studying the continuity of a piecewise function and fixing the parameter that makes it continuous; applying Bolzano to locate a root.
Término general y suma de una progresión: The general term and the sum of a progression; deciding whether a series converges; computing an instalment, a final capital or an effective rate.
Un examen de bloque es un simulacro hech: A block exam is a mock paper taken at home: with a clock, no notes and no hints. The questions come from the exercises of the 21 topics of the block, spread across sections, and every time you start one the numbers are different and so are the topics: doing it several times covers the whole block. On submission everything is marked, the step-by-step solution of each question opens, and the mark comes out section by section, with links to what is worth revising. The “tailored to what you have done” option puts first what you have not solved yet: it is the way to check that no topic is left untouched.
Veintiún temas, el bloque más largo del: Twenty-one topics, the longest block of the course and the one that weighs most in the entrance exam: from the concept of a function to the theorem that joins the derivative to the integral. This topic teaches nothing new: it asks. A procedural exam with exercises from the whole block, with a clock and no hints, to know which part of the analysis is really done.
